Шаг 4. The “What the scale prints in the barcode” block: each prefix has the buttons “Weight” and “Amount”. The note next to it says “till rule”, “company mode” or “the till asks on the first scan”.
Шаг 5. “All prefixes 20–29” shows all prefixes, “Only prefixes in use” returns the short list. “Reset rules (the till will ask again)” removes all till rules.
Шаг 6. The “How the till reads the scale label barcode” block: an example barcode, the company layout and mode from the website, the amount unit; the “Barcode format on the scale itself: …” button opens the brand settings on the “Barcode” tab.
Важно: A till rule is stronger than the company mode from the website and works at once, without a restart. The same “Weight” / “Amount” buttons are at the bottom of the “Label scales” tab, and “Set up from a label…” is also in the “Send goods to the scale” window. The rules are stored only on this computer.

articles.title: How to sell a product with a scale label
articles.text:
Шаг 1. Scan the barcode on the scale label (the cursor must not be in an input field — press Esc).
Шаг 2. The POS finds the weighed product by the code from the barcode and immediately adds a line to the receipt with the weight and total from the label — the “Weigh product” window does not open.
Шаг 3. If this prefix (21–24 or 26–29) is scanned for the first time, answer the “amount or weight” question.
Шаг 4. Compare the receipt line with the label and take payment as usual.
Шаг 5. Weigh products without a label on the scale at the till: tap the product in the catalog (the “Weighed” tab), in the “Weigh product” window use “Read from scale” or enter “Weight, kg” manually (or the “By amount” tab), then “Add to receipt”.
Важно: The message “Product with code … was not found in the catalog.” means the product's PLU or code does not match or “Weighed product” is not turned on — see “Product not found by a scale label”.

articles.title: The scale is not found on the network or there is no connection
articles.text:
Шаг 1. Check that the scale is on and the network cable is connected (the lights on the socket are on).
Шаг 2. The computer and the scale must be in the same subnet: the first three numbers of the address match (for example, 192.168.1.20 and 192.168.1.151). Click “Find on network…” in the scale settings window — if the scale is in another subnet, the POS says so under the row and suggests a new address.
Шаг 3. Check the port: Shtrih-PRINT — 1111, TM-30F — 4001, Rongta — 5001 (for checking).
Шаг 4. Close the manufacturer's software (“Russian Scale”, RLS1000) if it keeps the scale busy.
Шаг 5. Windows Firewall or an antivirus may block the connection — allow the POS to access the network.
Шаг 6. Shtrih-PRINT rejected the password — turn the scale off and on and enter the correct password (usually 0030).
Важно: Scales often do not answer ping but are visible in the ARP table — so rely on the network search, not only on “Check connection”.

articles.title: Product not found by a scale label
articles.text:
The POS says “Product with code 01003 was not found in the catalog.”
Шаг 1. Open the product card: “Weighed product” must be on and “PLU code (for scales)” filled in (with the “by code” layout — “SKU”).
Шаг 2. Compare the code from the message with the product's PLU: 01003 = PLU 1003.
Шаг 3. If the code differs, check the “Barcode code” column in the “Send goods to the scale” window and send the products to the scale again.
Шаг 4. Check the barcode format: the “Barcode” tab in your brand's settings window must show “The till reads: …”. If it says “The till will NOT recognise the item”, click “Match the till” or “Recommended for the till”.
Шаг 5. If the POS did not recognise the label as a weight label and offers to add a product to the warehouse, the barcode does not start with 20–29 or does not have 13 digits: change the prefix on the scale.
Важно: A product just added on the website appears in the POS after the catalog synchronizes (up to a couple of minutes).

articles.title: The receipt total does not match the label
articles.text:
Шаг 1. Compare the label and the receipt. If the label says 13.20 som and the receipt shows 1.320 kg and 79.20 som, the POS read the amount as a weight (or vice versa).
Шаг 2. Open ☰ → “Settings” → “Scales” → “Barcode: weight / amount”, the “Set up from a label” block: scan this label, click “Read” and choose the option that matches the label. The POS starts reading this prefix that way at once.
Шаг 3. Or in the “What the scale prints in the barcode” block click “Weight” or “Amount” next to the prefix. This works for any prefix 20–29: a till rule is stronger than the company mode from the website.
Шаг 4. The amount is 100 times smaller or larger — the amount unit (tiyin or som) in the company settings on the website does not match, and for TM-30F also “Price on the scale (Price point)”.
Шаг 5. A difference of a few tiyin is rounding. Check that the product price in the POS and on the scale is the same: after changing a price, send the products to the scale again.
Важно: The price on the scale changes only after the products are sent to the scale again.

articles.title: The label shows “РУБ” instead of “СОМ”
articles.text:
Шаг 1. Shtrih-PRINT scales: open “ShTRIH-PRINT scale settings” → “Currency” and go through the “Caption «ЦЕНА, РУБ/КГ» → your currency” wizard (article “Shtrih-PRINT: “СОМ” instead of “РУБ” on the label”).
Шаг 2. In the same place, in “Currency sign”, upload the som sign and turn on “currency signs” on the “Printing & label” tab.
Шаг 3. TM-30F and Rongta: captions on the label are changed in the manufacturer's software (“Russian Scale”, RLS1000) — the POS does not send them.
Важно: The text «ЦЕНА, РУБ/КГ» is built into the Shtrih-PRINT firmware — the POS does not rewrite it but hides it and puts your text in its place in your own format 1–5.

articles.title: The weight does not come from the scale at the till (COM port)
articles.text:
Шаг 1. In ☰ → “Settings” → “Scales” → “Scale at the till” check that “Enable scale polling” is on and the correct “COM port” is selected (the port number is shown in Windows Device Manager → “Ports (COM & LPT)”).
Шаг 2. “Baud rate” must match the scale (often 9600, sometimes 4800 or 2400).
Шаг 3. If the scale gives the weight only on request, enter the “Weight request (hex)” from the scale manual and a “Poll interval (ms)” greater than 0.
Шаг 4. Click “Save”, put a product on the scale and click “Test scales”.
Шаг 5. If the port is used by another program, close it (the POS shows the port status under the port list).
Шаг 6. “The scale is not connected — enter the weight manually.” in the “Weigh product” window means the POS is not receiving the weight now: enter the weight manually and check the connection after the sale.
Важно: The message “No weight reading from the scale.” after “Read from scale” means the weight has not arrived yet: wait until the scale settles and click again.

articles.title: The letters ң, ө, ү and long names on the scale
articles.text:
Шаг 1. TM-30F: the scale understands only the Windows-1251 encoding, so the POS replaces ң, ө, ү with н, о, у and cuts the name to 43 characters.
Шаг 2. Shtrih-PRINT: the scale cannot print ң, ө, ү — write the name for the scale without them.
Шаг 3. Rongta: the scale does not print Cyrillic — the name is sent in Latin letters.
Шаг 4. To get a readable name on the label, shorten it in the product card and send the products to the scale again.
Важно: In the POS and on the receipt the name stays full and with Kyrgyz letters — only what goes to the scale changes.

articles.title: The receipt doesn't print — what should I do?
articles.text:
Шаг 1. Check that the printer is on, has paper, its cover is closed, and the cable is connected.
Шаг 2. Make sure “Print receipt” is turned on in the payment window.
Шаг 3. Open ☰ → “Settings” → “Print”, click “Find”, select the printer in the list, and click “Test”.
Шаг 4. If garbled characters are printed, change the “Encoding” and “ESC t table” (do not use “0 — PC437 (no Cyrillic)”) and click “Save”.
Шаг 5. If the POS says “The printer is not printing…”, the sale has already gone through — fix the printer and print the receipt from “Sales” → “Print receipt”.
Шаг 6. If this doesn't help, contact “Support”.
Важно: Starting with version 1.17.16, the POS automatically removes its own old stuck receipts from the Windows print queue — they no longer block new receipts and don't suddenly print later.

articles.title: The POS says “out of stock” or asks you to restock — what should I do?
articles.text:
Шаг 1. If the “Product ran out at the warehouse” window appears, the warehouse data shows that this product is out of stock.
Шаг 2. If you actually have the product, click “Confirm and add”.
Шаг 3. In the “Restock warehouse” window, enter how much of the product you actually have, and click “Add and sell”.
Шаг 4. If you don't have the product, click “Show similar products” and offer a substitute.
Шаг 5. Later, correct the stock levels via “Warehouse” → “Receiving” or “Stocktake (inventory)”.
Важно: Such sales are listed in “Irregular receipts” for reconciliation. Services are sold without tracking stock.

articles.title: A product can't be found by its barcode — what should I do?
articles.text:
Шаг 1. Check that the cursor is not in the search field (press Esc) and that the scanner reads the code.
Шаг 2. Click “Refresh catalog” in the catalog to load new products from the server.
Шаг 3. Find the product by name and check its “Barcode” in the product card (☰ → “Warehouse” → “Edit”).
Шаг 4. If the product does not exist, click “Add to warehouse” in the “Product not found” window and create it.
Шаг 5. If the product has several barcodes, add the missing one under “Additional barcodes”.
Важно: Weight labels (13 digits, starting with 20–29) are looked up by the product's PLU — check the “PLU code (for scales)” in the product card and the weight barcode format in the company settings on the NurCRM website.

articles.title: No internet — can I still sell?
articles.text:
Шаг 1. Yes, keep selling as usual: receipts are saved on the POS.
Шаг 2. The top bar shows “Offline” and a “Queued: N” counter — these are receipts that have not been sent yet.
Шаг 3. When the connection is restored, the receipts are sent to the server automatically.
Шаг 4. You can check unsent receipts in ☰ → “Work” → “Irregular receipts” and resend them with the “Resend” button.
Важно: Stocktakes and write-offs do not work without internet. Fully standalone operation without a NurCRM account is enabled with a key via “Work offline (no internet)” on the login screen.

articles.title: A shift won't open — what should I do?
articles.text:
Шаг 1. If the POS says “Shift is already open”, first close the current shift with the “Close shift” button.
Шаг 2. Check your internet connection: without it, the server may not accept the shift opening.
Шаг 3. If “Shift is not open” appears during payment, just click “Pay” again: the POS checks with the server and offers to open a shift — the receipt is not lost.
Шаг 4. If the POS says “You already have an open shift on register …”, close that shift on that register or on the NurCRM website, or select that register in Settings → “Screen” → “Till”.
Шаг 5. If the POS says that no register matches the branch, ask the administrator to check that the register is linked to the branch on the NurCRM website.
Важно: The POS works only in the current cashier's own shift. Another cashier's shift on the same register does not get in the way — the POS opens a separate one.

articles.title: How do I update the program?
articles.text:
Шаг 1. Open ☰ → “Settings” → “Updates”.
Шаг 2. Click “Check for updates”.
Шаг 3. If there is a new version, click “Update” and wait for the program to restart.
Шаг 4. If something goes wrong after the update, go to “Roll back to a previous version” on the same tab and click “Show versions” → “Roll back”.

articles.title: A service requires stock — what should I do?
articles.text:
Шаг 1. Open ☰ → “Work” → “Warehouse” and find this item.
Шаг 2. Click “Edit” and check the type at the top of the card: “Service” must be selected, not “Product”.
Шаг 3. Select “Service” and click “Save”.
Шаг 4. Click “Refresh catalog” on the main screen and try to sell again.
Важно: Services are sold without tracking stock. For a one-off service without a product card, use “Extra service” under the receipt. If this does not help, update the program.

articles.title: Why don't the numbers in the POS and on the website match?
articles.text:
Шаг 1. Check that the same period (day, week, or month) is selected in the POS and on the website.
Шаг 2. Check that all receipts have been sent: the top bar must not show “Queued: N”, and “Irregular receipts” must be empty.
Шаг 3. Keep in mind: credit sales are shown in the receipt list but are not included in the “Revenue” tile, and partial returns are not subtracted from revenue — the website calculates it the same way.
Шаг 4. Click “Refresh” in the “Finance” or “Sales” window.
Шаг 5. Update the POS to the latest version (Settings → “Updates”).
Важно: If the numbers still differ, send support screenshots from the POS and the website for the same period.

articles.title: A cashier can't see a menu section — why?
articles.text:
Шаг 1. Starting with the “Standard” plan, the warehouse, sales, finance, salary, ABC analysis, clients, and restocking sections are in the “NurMarket Owner” program (shortcut on the desktop), not in the POS.
Шаг 2. Other sections are shown only if the employee has permission to see them — permissions are granted to each employee in NurCRM (the web panel).
Шаг 3. Some sections become available only after an add-on is activated (Marketplace → “Extras”).
Шаг 4. After permissions are changed, sign out of the POS and sign in again.
